duas.transliteration: Allāhumma munzila 'l-kitāb, sarī'a 'l-ḥisāb, ihzimi 'l-aḥzāb, Allāhumma-hzimhum wa zalzilhum
duas.english_translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَاب سَرِيعَ الْحِسَاب اهْزِم الأَحْزَاب اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَ زَلْزِلْهُم
